pages.title: Fleeting Bloom
pages.text: Cactus Flower · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Cactus Flower Tea Bag in a teapot with water; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)Do we truly live on earth? Not forever on earth, only a little while here.$(br2)— Nezahualcoyotl

pages.title: Effect
pages.text: Grants Speed, Strength, Haste and Resistance at once.$(br2)$(br2)Speed 1:00, Strength 1:00, Haste 1:00, Resistance 1:00
